# Rapid-development advice (synthetic policy 1.0.0)

## Applicable design advice

For this finite 1,000-line offline task, prefer a direct in-memory ID map and
per-SKU totals over a database or a general framework unless a specific
requirement makes another choice simpler. One coherent package and a concise
decision in the original plan are normally enough. This is advice, not a
requirement to use a particular algorithm or to reduce file/prompt counts.

Do not inherit strict-change's formal publication-fault checkpoint or owned
rollback rehearsal. Voluntary atomic publication is allowed, but does not turn
the strict procedure into a rapid-development obligation. Preserve R1-R6 and
real independent review. navigation.high_risk_workflows is route advice, not
permission to skip approval already required by the task or host.
